hints.umbrella: Hold a pole overhead, push it open, and tilt it against heavy wind and rain.
hints.birthday: Light candles, blow them out with a big breath, and clap while people sing.
hints.rain: Wiggle your fingers down from above, shield your head, and splash through puddles.
hints.sleep: Rest your head on your hands, close your eyes, and snore loudly.
hints.shopping: Push a cart, pick things off shelves, check prices, and carry heavy bags.
hints.swimming: Stroke your arms in big circles and kick your legs, coming up to breathe.
hints.wedding: Walk slowly down an aisle, put a ring on someone's finger, and throw something up in the air.
hints.dancing: Move your whole body to a beat, spin around, and grab a partner.
hints.football: Dribble a ball with your feet, shoot, and celebrate a goal with a slide on your knees.
hints.fishing: Cast a long rod, wait patiently, then yank and reel in something heavy.
hints.traffic jam: Grip a steering wheel, honk, stare at long stopped cars, and bang your head on the wheel.
hints.power outage: Stand still, look up, flick a switch that does nothing, and fumble around in the dark.
hints.picnic: Spread out a blanket, unpack food from a basket, and swat away flies.
hints.job interview: Straighten your tie, shake hands, sit nervously, and answer questions while sweating.
hints.dentist visit: Lie back with your mouth wide open, flinch at a drill, and spit into a small sink.
hints.moving house: Carry heavy boxes, strain to lift a couch, and sigh at piles of stuff.
hints.camping: Put up a small tent, hammer in pegs, sit around a fire, and swat bugs.
hints.road trip: Drive, sing along to a radio, point at the view, and look at a map.
hints.haircut: Sit still in a chair under a cape while someone snips around your head.
hints.surprise party: Hide, crouch quietly, then jump out together with open arms when someone walks in.
hints.lost keys: Pat all your pockets, dig through a bag, and look under cushions with rising panic.
hints.long queue: Shuffle forward one step, check your watch, and peer ahead with a sigh.
hints.birthday cake: Carry something flat with flickering lights, then cut a slice and lick your lips.
hints.snowball fight: Scoop up cold stuff, pack it in your hands, and throw it, ducking from incoming ones.
hints.first day of school: Put on a heavy backpack, wave goodbye nervously, and hold your teacher's hand.
hints.jet lag: Yawn through the middle of the day, rub your eyes, and look at a watch in confusion.
hints.déjà vu: Freeze, look around slowly, then point at your head as if you have been here before.
hints.stage fright: Peek out from behind a curtain, tremble, forget your lines, and run away.
hints.awkward silence: Look around at others, cough, shuffle your feet, and fidget with a smile that is forced.
hints.sleepwalking: Walk with arms out in front and eyes closed, drifting around like a ghost.
hints.rush hour: Push through a crowd, hang onto a pole, check your watch, and squeeze onto a train.
hints.garage sale: Lay out stuff on a table, point at prices, and bargain with a buyer.
hints.bad hair day: Look in a mirror, pat down wild hair that keeps popping up, and give up with a groan.
hints.stuck elevator: Press buttons again and again, bang on the doors, and pace in a tiny box.
hints.group photo: Squeeze together, fix your smile, and wait for a timer to count down.
hints.speed dating: Sit face to face, smile, chat for a short moment, then ring a bell and move to the next seat.
